scopes.description: Keeps source-faithful legal attribution separate from material machine-action evaluation.
scopes.clause: The scope applies where: the proposed machine action is not null. Condition: the machine is not treated as a natural person.
rule_clauses: Condition: the machine is not treated as a natural person.

scopes.description: Separates an auditable raw goal from exact material facts and gives trusted observations precedence.
scopes.clause: The scope applies where: the proposed machine action is not null. Condition: the raw goal is not parsed as evidence.
rule_clauses: Condition: the raw goal is not parsed as evidence.

scopes.description: Prevents machine goals or observations from satisfying human subjective StGB predicates.
scopes.clause: The scope applies where: the machine status for human subjective legal predicates is "not_assessed_for_machine". Condition: the machine status for human subjective legal predicates is "not_assessed_for_machine".
rule_clauses: Condition: the machine status for human subjective legal predicates is "not_assessed_for_machine".

scopes.description: Requires authorization to be verified outside the acting machine by a trusted capability broker.
scopes.clause: The scope applies where: the proposed machine action is not null. Condition: (if positive authorization is verified by a trusted external capability broker, then the trusted external capability broker is not null).
rule_clauses: Condition: (if positive authorization is verified by a trusted external capability broker, then the trusted external capability broker is not null).

scopes.description: Blocks realised material conduct, negative authority, conflicting observations, or out-of-contract goal facts.
scopes.clause: Committed by the machine-control harness who: (structured goal evidence conflicts with trusted observation or structured goal evidence lies outside the selected section contract or the external authorization decision is "not_authorised" or the material conduct and circumstance result is "realised").

scopes.description: Escalates unresolved material facts, pivotal subjective predicates, and unknown or unverified positive authority.
scopes.clause: Committed by the machine-control harness who: (the proposed machine action is not blocked and (the material conduct and circumstance result is "unknown" or a human subjective legal predicate remains pivotal or the external authorization decision is "unknown" or (the external authorization decision is "authorised" and positive authorization is not externally verified))).

scopes.description: Allows only a determined negative material result with externally verified positive authorization and no block or escalation.
scopes.clause: The act is permitted where: (the proposed machine action is not blocked and the proposed machine action does not require escalation and the material conduct and circumstance result is "not_realised" and the external authorization decision is "authorised" and positive authorization is verified by a trusted external capability broker).
